newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador inflation -0.6 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador inflation -0.6 pct in September.

text.p: Salvadorean inflation was -0.6 percent in September, down from 1.5 percent in August, the Economy Ministry said on Wednesday.
Accumulated inflation in the first nine months of the year was 7.6 percent, compared with 10.3 percent in the same period last year.
Year-on-year, inflation was 8.7 percent to September.

It was the first decline in monthly inflation this year, and was fueled largely by bumper harvets of grains, fruits and vegetables that cut prices in the local market, the ministry said. The government is targetting less than 10 percent inflation this year.
